name: Blake Blossom career
content: Blake Blossom's career highlights: Won AVN Best New Starlet 2022; Co-hosted the 2025 AVN Awards; Runs her own platforms, original series, reaction videos, and a comic book project

name: Blake Blossom personal
content: About Blake Blossom: Born March 14, 2000 in Scottsdale, Arizona; attended Arizona State University before entering the industry in 2020. Her family knows about and supports her career.

name: Blake Blossom quotes
content: Things Blake Blossom has said: Being in adult industry has helped me become the person I really am on the inside.

name: Blake Blossom voice
content: Blake Blossom's speaking style: Surprisingly open and plain-spoken in interviews — talks candidly about her work, finances, and stigma with sharp humor. Entertainer energy: fast, funny, story-driven, with comic-book and horror-nerd detours.
